あらすじ

In a barren desert region untouched by royal rule for centuries, there exists a city that has maintained its autonomy — a place known as “Sodom”, a haven of worldly desires and pleasures.

At the heart of this lawless city stands a massive colosseum where grotesque monsters fight against challengers in brutal matches. Losing doesn’t mean death — it means being publicly violated in front of cheering crowds. Such acts are commonplace in Sodom.

あらすじ

The Elfin Empire, where elves and humans live together, is ruled by the high elves and surrounded by a deep forest. Goblin tribe, led by a shaman Zodom, attacks the country with their mechanical beasts and the princesses are bestowed with new powers to defend the nation. However, years later, the cardinal Gedlf conspires to take over the kingdom and makes a deal with goblins to make the noble elf princesses his own using immoral means. The princesses are marked with a curse that turns their bodies into lustful beings, losing their divine powers and becoming slaves.

  • 英語名: Haiboku no Injuu Hunter Gehhyouki Rei Meimon Jogakusei to Tomo ni Shokushu no Naedoko ni Sareru Bishoujo Kenshi

あらすじ

Beasts are heteromorphic creatures, who are an enemy of mankind. Rei, nicknamed “Gehhyouki”, is the strongest swordswoman, who has killed a number of those abominations.

Rei, along with her partner Arisa, are given charge to bodyguard Princess Aphrodia, who is studying abroad in Japan as their classmate. However, the Princess’ birthday party is attacked by a terrorist organization composed of beasts and led by a mysterious figure. The invitees are taken hostage, and Rei and Arisa themselves are also captured.

As a new school year begins, Yamashita starts searching for new targets, with the aim of training them as sex slaves by exploiting their weaknesses.
